title: parseSubclasses emits duplicate subclass:champion from SRD 5.1 PDF
description:
With loreweaver-8gp (parseFeatures Destroy Undead + Eldritch Invocations dedup) landing, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack now passes the feature-duplicate check but hits the NEXT pipeline failure:

> importer failed: records has duplicate key: subclass:champion

Reproduce: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack on a tree that has loreweaver-8gp merged.

Investigation pointers:
- This failure is pre-existing — it was masked by the parseFeatures duplicate firing first.
- The duplicate is in parseSubclasses, not parseFeatures.
- Likely cause: the Champion subclass heading appears twice in the real SRD layout — once as the Champion subclass intro within the Fighter chapter, and possibly again somewhere else (e.g. an index-style reference). Or the parser is treating a body-prose mention of "Champion" as a fresh subclass heading.
- See packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSubclasses.ts and its tests at packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSubclasses.test.ts.
- The fix pattern from loreweaver-8gp (output-level dedup+merge keyed by record key) may apply directly.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #137: parseSubclasses now disambiguates subclass-name lines by current parent class, rejecting the 'Champion' column-wrap from the Barbarian level-20 'Primal Champion' progression-table row. Real-PDF regression test added. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack no longer fails on subclass:champion duplicate key.
